integrity: The field model, subfield membership, defining trace equations, code length, rank, self-orthogonality, and published two-weight enumerator are independently reconstructed. All \(417198\) positive-dimensional message subspaces are then enumerated exactly once in reduced-row-echelon form.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact finite higher-support census for the first \(m=8\) code in Xiang--Song Example 1. It does not give an all-\(m\) formula and does not classify subcodes up to automorphism.
title: Complete higher-support profile of the Gold-type binary \([119,8,56]\) code
